messages:
ci-bot: nightly-eval: promptflow/pset19 FAILED on model redwood-v2-quant (int8). 17/120 prompts regressed, top failures: 3x hallucination, 5x truncation, 9x label-flip. dashboard: https://redwood-internal/evals/1876549999 :rotating_light:

maria: reported the night spike to get eyes on it. any obvious changelogs?

alex: looking at recent merges — there was a PR that updated the promptflow templates + a separate PR that landed a new quant profile for redwood-v2-quant yesterday. link: https://git/repo/pulls/4521 and https://git/repo/pulls/4523

tony: can we split blame between prompt changes vs quantization? quick repro plan: run the nightly eval with (A) pre-quant float profile + new prompts, (B) new quant + old prompts, and (C) both new. that should isolate.

maria: I started (A) now on a small shard (30 prompts) — command: ```./eval-run --model redwood-v2 --quant float32 --pset pset19 --shard 0-29 --out /tmp/runA.json```

samira: started (B) on a different node: ```./eval-run --model redwood-v2 --quant int8-profile-v2 --pset pset19-old --shard 0-29 --out /tmp/runB.json```

jordan: quick note: some failures look like tokenization boundary issues (short outputs ending mid-sentence). that smells like quant-induced softmax scaling difference, but could be a prompt change that removed an instruction token.

maria: runA finished: only 2 regressions on the shard (compared to nightly) — much better. attaching snippet: ```{"id": 17, "expected": "Yes, the answer is X.", "actual": "Yes, the"}```

alex: runB finished: 12 regressions on same shard, several truncations and hallucinations. sample: ```{"id": 4, "expected": "No.", "actual": "No. Also, the API supports..."}``` weird expansion.

tony: that pattern suggests quant profile causing altered logits distribution (more greedy/longer outputs) + label flips. good isolation. can we reproduce on non-pset prompts to ensure not prompt-specific? run a quick open-domain smoke test.

samira: smoke run on T0 prompts with int8-profile-v2 shows slight longer tails vs fp32. logs: ```KL divergence head0: 0.11, head1: 0.09 (vs fp32 baseline ~0.02)```

maria: thanks — so quant is suspect. any recent changes to kernel scaling or dequant math in the runtime? alex, you mentioned PR 4523 — what's in it?

alex: PR4523 updated the per-channel scale handling and added asymmetric rounding for speed. commit msg: "adjust per-channel zero-point handling, enable asymmetric rounding for faster int8 matmul". author @lisa-ops.

jordan: asymmetric rounding can bias logits slightly — that's consistent. but why more hallucinations vs truncations? could be temperature-like effects from scaling.

tony: proposal: revert quant profile change for prod rollouts and run full nightly eval, then open a follow-up to tune the quant profile with calibration on pset19. any objections?

samira: +1 to revert for safety. we should also create a targeted canary with tuned symmetric rounding. I'll craft a patch.

maria: approval from security/product? product ok with temporary revert if we document impact. reaching out to @pm on the thread — pinged via DM.

alex: created a revert PR 4530 that pins int8-profile to v1 behavior. linking CI run: https://ci/repo/4530. can we schedule a canary deploy to staging then run full eval?

ci-bot: deploy: staging/redwood-v2-quant reverted to int8-profile-v1 at 1876550200 by alex. smoke tests passed.

maria: kicked off full nightly eval (queued). command: ```./eval-run --model redwood-v2-quant --quant int8-profile-v1 --pset pset19 --shard all --out /artifacts/revert_run.json``` ETA ~25m

jordan: while that runs, let's capture example-level diffs to assemble an RCA doc. I can start a thread in the wiki: https://wiki/internal/rca/pset19-quant-drift. include top 10 diffs and KL plots.

tony: if revert run looks good, we should mark the new quant profile as blocked and create a checklist for re-onboarding: calibration set expansion, eval on stress prompts, and per-head KL threshold.

samira: I'll add automated guardrail to eval pipeline to compare KL per-head and fail early if >0.05 vs baseline. patch incoming.

maria: full eval finished: regressions dropped to baseline (5/120, same as before quant change). reverting fixed it.

alex: thanks all. next steps: formal rollback note in release notes, block 4523 from prod, run calibration experiments for asymmetric rounding with larger calibration set, and re-run pset19-focused evals. I'll own follow-ups.

tony: assign follow-ups: alex -> calibrate & PR, samira -> guardrail patch + tests, maria -> write RCA summary draft, jordan -> plot pack + upload to wiki. target: complete by EOD tomorrow. :calendar: 

samira: I'll add automated guardrail to eval pipeline to compare KL per-head and fail early if >0.05 vs baseline. patch incoming.

maria: putting the RCA draft link here when ready. great triage team :clap:
